post_title: What will Japan's October 2026 domestic corporate goods price index (CGPI) year-on-year change be?

question.title: What will Japan's October 2026 domestic corporate goods price index (CGPI) year-on-year change be?
question.description:
Japan's Corporate Goods Price Index (CGPI, 企業物価指数) is the Bank of Japan's monthly measure of prices of goods traded between companies — the wholesale/producer-price counterpart to the consumer price index. The headline series used here is the domestic CGPI for all commodities, a fixed-base (Laspeyres) index with 2020 average = 100, reported with both a month-on-month (前月比) and a year-on-year (前年同月比) change.

Status quo: in the most recent release — preliminary figures for September 2026, published October 13, 2026 — the domestic CGPI stood at 135.7, down 0.3% month-on-month and up 6.8% year-on-year. The August 2026 figure was revised to +7.6% y/y, and the July–September quarter averaged 136.1, +7.3% y/y. Japanese wholesale inflation has therefore run at roughly 6–8% through 2026, following index annual averages of 119.9 (2023), 122.8 (2024) and 126.8 (2025). The September report showed strong upward pressure from nonferrous metals (+40.2% y/y) and from imported petroleum, coal and natural gas (+43.6% y/y in yen terms), while agricultural, forestry and fishery products fell 13.3% y/y and subtracted 0.42 percentage points from the monthly change; export prices were +17.9% y/y and import prices +24.5% y/y in yen terms, with the dollar-yen rate down 1.5 yen on the month in September. The chained (連鎖方式) reference index rose 6.2% y/y in September.

The October 2026 preliminary figures are due at 8:50 a.m. JST on Thursday, November 12, 2026, per the Bank of Japan's release calendar (https://www.boj.or.jp/en/about/calendar/index.htm). The print is genuinely uncertain because the year-on-year rate combines the October 2026 month-on-month move with the October 2025 base level: recent monthly changes have been small (around -0.3% to +0.5%), so plausible outcomes cluster in the mid-6% range but span a wide band. The reading matters for the policy debate: the Bank of Japan's October 29–30, 2026 meeting and Outlook Report framed the inflation outlook ahead of its next meeting on December 17–18, 2026.

question.resolution_criteria: This question resolves according to the year-on-year (前年同月比) percentage change of Japan's domestic Corporate Goods Price Index (国内企業物価指数) — all commodities (総平均), 2020 average = 100, fixed-base index — for October 2026, as first published by the Bank of Japan in the Monthly Report on the Corporate Goods Price Index (Preliminary Figures for October 2026). That release is scheduled for 8:50 a.m. JST on November 12, 2026 and is listed at https://www.boj.or.jp/statistics/pi/cgpi_release/index.htm (the October 2026 report is expected at https://www.boj.or.jp/statistics/pi/cgpi_release/cgpi2610.pdf). The resolution value is the headline year-on-year figure for that index in the release: for example, if the report shows a year-on-year change of ＋6.4％ (前年同月比), the question resolves as 6.4. The chained (連鎖方式) reference index and the "summer electricity rate adjusted" (夏季電力料金調整後) variant are not used. If the release is delayed, the question resolves when the preliminary October 2026 figures are published; if the Bank of Japan never publishes preliminary October 2026 CGPI figures, the question is annulled.
question.fine_print: Revisions to the October 2026 figure, or to earlier months, appearing in later CGPI releases (e.g. the November and December 2026 reports) do not change the answer; only the figure first published in the preliminary October 2026 report counts.
